name: Wizard Island
text: Wizard Island is a volcanic cinder cone which forms an island at the west end of Crater Lake in Crater Lake National Park, Oregon. The top of the island reaches 6,933 feet (2,113 m) above sea level, about 755 feet (230 m) above the average surface of the lake. The cone is capped by a volcanic crater about 500 feet (150 m) wide and 100 feet (30 m) deep.

depictions.name: Wizard Island
depictions.text: Wizard Island is a major safe zone in the second half of Days Gone. Serving as an encampment and the main base of operations for the Deschutes County Militia, vital personnel were protected extensively under armed guard as Colonel Garret sought to utilize the island as a major stepping stone to retake Oregon — and eventually the country — from the Freaker Hordes. However, as the DCM suffered substantial losses from marauders, Garret instead sought to eliminate all remaining survivor encampments in Oregon.
